descripcion_geo: Town on the border between Judah and Benjamin on the northern edge of the Dead Sea.
importancia_estrategica: Border point between the tribes of Judah and Benjamin.

historias.descripcion: Beth-Arabá was a city on the border of Judah that reached north of the Dead Sea.
Abi-albon the Arabatite and Azmaveth the Baharumite were among the heroes of David, from Beth-Arabá.

historias.titulo: Beth-Arabá in the division of Benjamin
historias.descripcion: The city was assigned to the tribe of Benjamin because of its location on the northern boundary.

personajes.descripcion: He assigned Beth-Arabá as the border point between Judah and Benjamin.
He received Beth-Arabá as part of his territorial inheritance.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Beth-Arabá: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Beth-Arabá marks the boundary between Judah and Benjamin next to the Dead Sea; Border towns define tribal identity in the AT.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Beth-Arabá marks the boundary between Judah and Benjamin next to the Dead Sea; Border towns define tribal identity in the AT.
